info.title: Sales Brand Styling
info.description: Extract a customer's brand, map a sales template to semantic roles, render it re-styled. Keep info.version equal to the VERSION file (check-release.mjs enforces this).

post.summary: Extract a BrandSpec from a URL or an uploaded file.

200.description: BrandSpec to be shown to the sales manager for confirmation.

post.description: Local files and folders are NOT accepted over HTTP (a server must not read caller-chosen paths). Use `node cli.mjs extract <path>` locally, or upload a single file via `file`.

post.summary: Parse an HTML/PPTX template into semantic roles and attach brand targets.

200.description: IR. Items in ir.uncertain have target:null until the user confirms one.

fonts.description: Human-readable font decisions (licence/substitution) to show the user.

post.summary: Apply an approved IR; returns the file plus a preview to show before delivery.

200.description: Styled file + sandboxed preview + change list.

post.summary: Draft a new editable PPTX in the customer's brand from a slide outline.

image.description: image layout only: a brand asset id (png/jpg), or "none" to leave an empty PowerPoint picture placeholder for the user's own picture. Omit to use the best brand photograph.

tone.description: Background tone for content, two-column, statement and image slides. Omit to follow the customer's site rhythm.

chart.description: Native chart. Numbers come from the user; never invented. sample:true labels the chart as sample data.

highlight.description: single series: the label (or position) to colour in the brand colour; the rest are muted

stats.description: highlight only: key-number tiles. Numbers come from the user; use [placeholders] otherwise.

aside_title.description: highlight only: heading of the side card

aside.description: highlight only: bullets of the side card

items.description: Core layouts have the fields shown; the 42 catalog layouts (see POST /slide_catalog) each take their own fields, validated strictly (unknown fields, oversize text and wrong list sizes are refused with a clear message).

no_highlight.description: Whole-deck builds add a highlight slide with placeholder figures before the closing slide unless the outline already has one or this is true.

logo.description: Optional png/jpg/svg up to 2 MB, placed on title and closing layouts.

fonts.description: Human-readable font decisions (licence/substitution) to show the user.

post.summary: Branded PPTX template: all six layouts, one labelled sample slide each.

post.summary: CSS block (variables, heading style, .brand-* classes incl. image heroes/logo) for an HTML artifact.

fonts.description: embed = inline latin woff2 of the Google Fonts in use (self-contained, no request to Google at view time); google-import = @import from fonts.googleapis.com (the viewer's browser contacts Google). Omit for neither.

post.summary: Visual brand board (HTML) for a non-designer to confirm: sample slides, colours, fonts, images, with C1/F1/I1 references.

site_screenshot_base64.description: Optional PNG (<3 MB) shown for comparison.

artifact.description: true = fragment without doctype/html/head/body, for publishing as an Artifact.

post.summary: HTML page in the customer's style. mode=prototype uses their measured components (nav, buttons, cards, footer); mode=onepager uses their design language only.

blocks.description: Page sections: nav, hero, statement, feature, cards, text, quote, cta, form, footer. Strings are escaped; hrefs may be #anchors or https; images are brand asset ids.

chart.description: Native chart. Numbers come from the user; never invented. sample:true labels the chart as sample data.

highlight.description: single series: the label (or position) to colour in the brand colour; the rest are muted

post.summary: Reference sheet of the customer's measured components, to confirm they look right.
The slide catalog: every catalog slide type with its summary and allowed fields, and the ready-made storylines (slide sequences).

BrandSpec.description: See schema/brand-spec.schema.json (schema_version 1.1; 1.0 still accepted). typography.*_font is the font actually used after the font policy.

surfaces.description: Colours that actually cover the page (screenshot area, or CSS backgrounds). Drives how slides use colour.

font_resolution.description: Per role: requested, used, status (google|system|user-licensed|substituted|default), license, basis, alternatives, web_fallback, note.

BrandStyle.description: BrandStyle (style_version 1.0): see schema/brand-style.schema.json. Optional; adds text style, image backgrounds, placed imagery.

design.description: Layout feel measured on the customer's live page: align, density, imagery, heading_scale, corners.

rhythm.description: Visual rhythm of the site, one entry per screen: pattern (alternating|dark|light|mixed), tones, imagery.

system.description: BrandSystem 1.0: the site's real components measured in a browser (container, section spacing, type scale, nav, buttons, cards, input, footer). Needed for html prototypes.
